Title: Realism
Text / Effect: Realism holds that the world has a stable structure that exists independently of human observation or interpretation. Reality is 'out there' waiting to be discovered through systematic investigation. Gameplay Effect: +2 points if your stack includes a Method with Reproducibility 8 or higher.

Title: Relativism
Text / Effect: Relativism argues that what we call 'reality' changes with culture, language, and history. Truth is relative to social, cultural, and historical contexts. Gameplay Effect: +2 points if your stack includes Methods from different paradigms (e.g., one with Reproducibility 7+ and one with Sensibility 7+).

Title: Constructivism
Text / Effect: Constructivism sees reality as something people actively build together through conversation, symbols, shared practices, and social interaction. What we call 'reality' is socially constructed. Gameplay Effect: When you complete a stack with 2+ Methods with Sensibility 7+, draw 1 card (then discard to 7).

Title: Critical Realism
Text / Effect: Critical Realism combines realist ontology with interpretive epistemology. Reality exists independently but can only be known through human interpretation and is stratified into layers. Bridges quantitative and qualitative approaches. Gameplay Effect: +3 points if your stack includes Methods with both high Reproducibility (6+) and high Sensibility (6+).

Title: Relational Ontology
Text / Effect: Relational Ontology sees reality as existing in relationships rather than isolated entities. Emphasizes interconnection, process, and context. Central to Indigenous philosophies and ecological thinking. Gameplay Effect: +3 points if your stack includes Participatory Methods, Action Research, or Ethnography.
